n = int(input())
s = input().strip()
result = [''] * n
left, right = 0, n - 1

for i in range(n):
    if (n - i) % 2 == 1:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        result[mid] = s[i]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    else:
        mid = (left + right) // 2 - 1
        result[mid] = s[i]
        left += 1

print(''.join(result))
